title: Index branch refs and graph coverage
summary: Build a read-only lookup keyed by repository, branch, graph kind and full source commit.
acceptance_criteria: Show the source SHA and state for main, a feature map, a version archive and a branch without a graph.
Group identical Graphify file sets while keeping every branch independently addressable.
Flag mismatched source SHAs without labeling them invalid when the snapshot is explicitly historical.

evidence.claim: AlderVale's main and feature snapshots are published under different paths and pin different source commits.
